sources.title: Usman Nurmagomedov, five others sentenced to six months in Abu Dhabi prison for attack on Merab Dvalishvili
Eight sentenced to jail over Nurmagomedov-Dvalishvili brawl

en.title: Eight people sentenced in Abu Dhabi brawl involving Nurmagomedov and Dvalishvili
en.dek: Eight individuals received prison sentences following a mass brawl between MMA fighters Usman Nurmagomedov and Merab Dvalishvili in Abu Dhabi.
facts: Eight people received prison sentences for their part in a mass brawl involving Usman Nurmagomedov and Merab Dvalishvili at a hotel in Abu Dhabi on Wednesday.
Six defendants received six months in prison and a fine of £62,000 each, and were ordered deported after sentencing, according to The National.
Two other defendants received six months in prison for violating privacy by filming and publishing footage of the brawl, according to The National.
Two remaining defendants were fined £10,200 each for disturbing public security and assaulting others, according to The National.
body: Authorities detained all parties involved immediately after the incident, and Abu Dhabi police later confirmed 10 arrests were made.
A video appeared to show Nurmagomedov slapping Dvalishvili after approaching the Georgian from behind, which preceded the fight between the two and their team members.
Chad Bronstein, RAF CEO and co-founder, stated that Merab Dvalishvili and his friend Saba Lazishvili had been released from police custody.
Dvalishvili stated on social media on Friday that he was released and expressed a wish for peace, adding he would not press charges.
en.context: The brawl occurred at a fighter hotel in Abu Dhabi ahead of a Real American Freestyle wrestling event, and Nurmagomedov was in Abu Dhabi to support his brother Umar Nurmagomedov.
en.imageCaption: A split picture of Merab Dvalishvili and Usman Nurmagomedov

fr.title: Huit personnes condamnées suite à une altercation à Abu Dhabi impliquant Nurmagomedov et Dvalishvili
fr.dek: Huit individus ont été condamnés à la suite d'une rixe impliquant les combattants de MMA Usman Nurmagomedov et Merab Dvalishvili à Abu Dhabi.
facts: Huit personnes ont reçu des peines de prison pour leur rôle dans une rixe impliquant Usman Nurmagomedov et Merab Dvalishvili dans un hôtel d'Abu Dhabi mercredi.
Six accusés ont reçu six mois de prison et une amende de 62 000 livres sterling chacun, et ont été ordonnés de quitter le pays après le procès, selon The National.
Deux autres accusés ont reçu six mois de prison pour violation de la vie privée en filmant et en publiant des images de la rixe, selon The National.
Deux accusés restants ont été condamnés à une amende de 10 200 livres sterling chacun pour trouble à l'ordre public et violences, selon The National.
body: Les autorités ont interpellé l'ensemble des personnes impliquées immédiatement après l'incident. La police d'Abu Dhabi a ensuite confirmé avoir procédé à 10 arrestations.
Une vidéo semblait montrer Nurmagomedov gifler Dvalishvili en s'approchant du Géorgien par derrière, ce qui avait précédé la bagarre entre les deux hommes et leurs équipes respectives.
Chad Bronstein, PDG et cofondateur de la RAF, a indiqué que Merab Dvalishvili et son ami Saba Lazishvili avaient été libérés de la garde à vue.
Dvalishvili a déclaré sur les réseaux sociaux vendredi qu'il avait été libéré et exprimé le souhait de la paix, ajoutant qu'il n'engagerait pas de procédure judiciaire.
fr.context: La rixe a eu lieu dans un hôtel de combattants à Abu Dhabi, en marge d'un événement de lutte Real American Freestyle, et Nurmagomedov était présent pour soutenir son frère Umar Nurmagomedov.
fr.imageCaption: Photo partagée en deux parties montrant Merab Dvalishvili et Usman Nurmagomedov

ja.title: アブダビでのヌルマゴメドフとドヴァリシュヴィリが関与した乱闘で8人が有罪判決
ja.dek: MMAファイターのウスマン・ヌルマゴメドフとメラブ・ドヴァリシュヴィリの間でアブダビで発生した大規模な乱闘を受け、8人が実刑判決を受けた
facts: 8人が水曜日、アブダビのホテルでウスマン・ヌルマゴメドフとメラブ・ドヴァリシュヴィリが関与した大規模な乱闘の件で実刑判決を受けた
ザ・ナショナル紙によると、6人の被告はそれぞれ6か月の懲役と62,000ポンドの罰金を科され、判決後国外退去を命じられた
ザ・ナショナル紙によると、他の2人の被告は乱闘の映像を撮影・公開したプライバシー侵害によりそれぞれ6か月の懲役刑を受けた
ザ・ナショナル紙によると、残りの2人の被告は公共の安全を乱し他者を暴行したとしてそれぞれ10,200ポンドの罰金を科された
body: 当局は事件直後に関係者全員を拘束し、アブダビ警察は後に10件の逮捕を確認した。
動画はヌルマゴメドフが背後に回り込み、ジョージア人のドヴァリシュヴィリに向かって平手打ちをする様子を映しており、これが二人の間の戦闘とそのチームメンバーの関与を引き起こした。
RAFのCEOで共同設立者のチャド・ブロンソンは、メラブ・ドヴァリシュヴィリとその友人のサバ・ラジシュヴィリが警察の拘束から解放されたと述べた。
ドヴァリシュヴィリは金曜日にSNSで、自身が解放されたことを表明し、平和を望む意向を示した上で、起訴しないと述べた。
ja.context: この乱闘は、リアル・アメリカン・フリースタイルレスリングのイベントに先立ちアブダビのファイターホテルで発生し、ヌルマゴメドフは弟のウマル・ヌルマゴメドフを支援するためにアブダビに滞在していた
ja.imageCaption: メラブ・ドヴァリシュヴィリとウスマン・ヌルマゴメドフの分割写真

es.title: Ocho personas sentenciadas por altercado en Abu Dabi entre Nurmagomedov y Dvalishvili
es.dek: Ocho individuos recibieron penas de prisión tras una pelea masiva entre los luchadores de MMA Usman Nurmagomedov y Merab Dvalishvili en Abu Dabi
facts: Ocho personas recibieron penas de prisión por su participación en un altercado masivo entre Usman Nurmagomedov y Merab Dvalishvili en un hotel de Abu Dabi el miércoles
Seis acusados recibieron seis meses de prisión y una multa de 62.000 libras cada uno, y fueron ordenados deportados tras la sentencia, según The National
Otros dos acusados recibieron seis meses de prisión por vulnerar la privacidad al grabar y publicar imágenes del altercado, según The National
Los dos acusados restantes fueron multados con 10.200 libras cada uno por alterar la seguridad pública y agredir a otros, según The National
body: Las autoridades detuvieron a todas las partes implicadas inmediatamente después del incidente, y la policía de Abu Dabi confirmó más tarde que se realizaron 10 arrestos.
Un vídeo mostró a Nurmagomedov dándole una bofetada a Dvalishvili tras acercarse por detrás al georgiano, lo que precedió a la pelea entre ambos y sus miembros del equipo.
Chad Bronstein, director ejecutivo de RAF y cofundador, declaró que Merab Dvalishvili y su amigo Saba Lazishvili habían sido liberados de la custodia policial.
Dvalishvili declaró en redes sociales el viernes que había sido liberado y expresó su deseo de paz, añadiendo que no presentaría cargos.
es.context: El altercado tuvo lugar en un hotel de luchadores en Abu Dabi antes de un evento de lucha libre Real American Freestyle, y Nurmagomedov se encontraba en Abu Dabi para apoyar a su hermano Umar Nurmagomedov
es.imageCaption: Una imagen dividida de Merab Dvalishvili y Usman Nurmagomedov

pt.title: Oito pessoas condenadas em briga em Abu Dhabi envolvendo Nurmagomedov e Dvalishvili
pt.dek: Oito indivíduos receberam penas de prisão após briga entre lutadores de MMA Usman Nurmagomedov e Merab Dvalishvili em Abu Dhabi
facts: Oito pessoas receberam penas de prisão pelo seu papel numa briga coletiva envolvendo Usman Nurmagomedov e Merab Dvalishvili num hotel em Abu Dhabi na quarta-feira.
Seis réus receberam seis meses de prisão e uma multa de 62.000 libras cada, e foram ordenados a serem deportados após a condenação, segundo The National.
Dois réus restantes receberam seis meses de prisão por violarem a privacidade ao filmar e publicar imagens da briga, segundo The National.
Dois réus restantes foram multados em 10.200 libras cada por perturbar a segurança pública e agredir outras pessoas, segundo The National.
body: Autoridades detiveram todas as partes envolvidas imediatamente após o incidente, e a polícia de Abu Dhabi confirmou mais tarde 10 detenções.
Um vídeo parecia mostrar Nurmagomedov a bater Dvalishvili após se aproximar do georgiano pelas costas, o que precedeu a luta entre os dois e os seus elementos de equipa.
Chad Bronstein, CEO e cofundador da RAF, afirmou que Merab Dvalishvili e o seu amigo Saba Lazishvili tinham sido libertados da custódia policial.
Dvalishvili afirmou nas redes sociais na sexta-feira que tinha sido libertado e expressou o desejo da paz, acrescentando que não iria processar.
pt.context: A briga ocorreu num hotel de lutadores em Abu Dhabi, à frente de um evento de luta livre Real American Freestyle, e Nurmagomedov estava em Abu Dhabi para apoiar o seu irmão Umar Nurmagomedov.
pt.imageCaption: Imagem dividida de Merab Dvalishvili e Usman Nurmagomedov

ko.title: 누르마고메도프와 드발리슈빌리 연루 아부다비 난투극 관련 8명 선고
ko.dek: MMA 선수 우스만 누르마고메도프와 메랍 드발리슈빌리 간의 대규모 난투극 후 8명에게 징역형 선고
facts: 8명은 수요일 아부다비의 한 호텔에서 우스만 누르마고메도프와 메랍 드발리슈빌리가 연루된 대규모 난투극에 가담한 혐의로 징역형을 선고받았다
더 내셔널에 따르면 6명의 피고인은 각각 6개월 징역과 62,000파운드의 벌금을 선고받았으며 선고 후 추방 명령을 받았다
더 내셔널에 따르면 다른 2명의 피고인은 난투극 영상을 촬영하고 게시하여 사생활 침해를 한 혐의로 각각 6개월 징역을 선고받았다
더 내셔널에 따르면 나머지 2명의 피고인은 공공 안전을 해치고 타인을 폭행한 혐의로 각각 10,200파운드의 벌금을 부과받았다
body: 당국은 사건 직후 관련자 전원을 구금했으며, 아부다비 경찰은 이후 10명이 체포된 사실을 확인했다.
한 영상이 누르마고메도프가 조지아인 드발리슈빌을 뒤에서 다가가 슬apping하는 모습을 보여주었으며, 이는 두 사람과 팀원들 사이의 싸움에 앞서 일어났다.
RAF CEO이자 공동 창업자인 채드 브론스테인은 메라브 드발리슈빌과 그의 친구 사바 라시슈빌이 경찰 구금에서 풀려났다고 밝혔다.
드발리슈빌은 금요일 SNS에 자신이 풀려났으며 평화를 바라는 마음을 표현하고 소송을 제기하지 않겠다고 덧붙였다고 밝혔다.
ko.context: 이 난투극은 리얼 아메리칸 프리스타일 레슬링 이벤트에 앞서 아부다비의 선수 호텔에서 발생했으며, 누르마고메도프는 동생 우마르 누르마고메도프를 지원하기 위해 아부다비에 머물고 있었다.
ko.imageCaption: 메랍 드발리슈빌리와 우스만 누르마고메도프의 분할 사진

problemsFixed: The headline is not a factual statement of what happened and exceeds the character limit if the full text is used.

The draft incorrectly aggregates the sentencing details; S1 states Nurmagomedov and five others got six months and $82,000 fine, while S2 details different punishments for different groups (six got six months/£62k, two got six months/£62k, two got £10.2k). The currency conversion ($82,000 vs £62,000) is not supported.
The draft uses vague attribution ('reports from Abu Dhabi judicial authorities') when specific outlets (CBS Sports, BBC Sport, The National) are cited.
The body paragraphs are repetitive and lack the required sentence variation (rhythm).
The context section is too brief and does not meet the requirement of explaining *why* it is happening using only source material.
